messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I have a Platinum Rewards Card and I think there’s some kind of annual fee rebate if you spend a certain amount each month. I’ve had the card for about a year now and I’m wondering if I qualify for the rebate. Can you check my account and let me know?

I can help — but first I need to verify your identity before I access your account. Please tell me which identifier you’d like me to use to look up your account (pick one):

- Rho user ID  
- The email address on your account  
- Your full name (exactly as on file)

After you provide one of those, I’ll pull your record and ask you to confirm any 2 of the following: date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), phone number, or mailing address. Do you want me to proceed?

Yes, please proceed.
